name: CRD-06 tubeless

origin.basis: CST is the Cheng Shin (正新) brand of Taiwan's Cheng Shin Rubber; China listings give the brand as CST/正新.

manufacturing.basis: The listings do not state the factory; Cheng Shin also makes bicycle tires at a mainland plant.

positioning: Low-cost 120 TPI tubeless road tire sold in China, often in two-packs.
weight_basis: No weight is given in the listing.

availability.note: Widely sold by mainland Taobao and Tmall shops; no official CST store was found, and CST's international site no longer showed model pages on 2026-11-01.

price_observations.market: 安贵运动户外专营店 (Tmall retailer)
price_observations.conditions: Retailer list price for one 28C tire without box before discounts; coupon price CNY 157.36. A two-tire box is CNY 376.48.

caveats: Owner reports of a loose bead: check the fit on your rim and keep pressure moderate.
No maker maximum pressure, hookless statement or independent test found.

owner_evidence.screening_note: Checked on 2026-11-03: keyed Xiaohongshu evidence from bounded searches (the first 16-20 result cards of each query, opened exact posts and their visible comments; not exhaustive), coded owner by owner, plus the Sigma Sports and bike-components catalogues and Bicycle Rolling Resistance's test index. Counted only owners who describe their own riding of this model; questions, seller and maker replies, unmounted impressions and reports about other models were left out.

reports.summary: Reported the bead coming off the rim on a descent; rim, pressure and size were not stated.

checks.note: One post; the publisher's replies are not counted
